draft.text: You came in because you have had back pain for about a week.
The pain started after you twisted your left side and has been constant since then.
The pain is in the middle of your lower back and sometimes goes to your left side.
It gets worse when you move suddenly to the left or twist.
You do not have numbness, tingling, or weakness in your legs.
You do not have a history of back problems or injuries.
You do not have fever, weight loss, or pain at night.
You work an office job that is not physically demanding.
The doctor mentioned ordering an X-ray as an outpatient.
You have not had it done yet.
The next steps will be discussed.
